title: The Cat Who Took A Number — EN/ES/MI (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Spanish Maori language learning absurdist dry comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, dry and unhurried]
A cat walked into a bank on a Tuesday
Approached the number dispenser
Took a ticket
The ticket said forty-seven

[Verse 1 - English]
The cat sat down in the waiting area
In the seat nearest the window
It waited
At four fifty-nine the bank manager came over
Sir, we're closing now
The cat looked at the number on the screen
The screen said thirty-one
The cat did not move
The bank manager said sir we really must close now
The cat's ticket said forty-seven
The screen said thirty-one

[Verse 2 - Español]
El gerente del banco vino a la mañana siguiente
(The bank manager came the next morning)
El gato todavía estaba en el asiento cerca de la ventana
(The cat was still in the seat near the window)
La pantalla decía treinta y cinco
(The screen said thirty-five)
El ticket del gato decía cuarenta y siete
(The cat's ticket said forty-seven)
El gato esperó
(The cat waited)
A las once y cuarenta y dos
(At eleven forty-two)
La pantalla dijo cuarenta y siete
(The screen said forty-seven)
El gato se levantó
(The cat got up)
Fue al mostrador
(Went to the counter)
Y abrió una cuenta de ahorros
(And opened a savings account)

[Chorus - Te Reo Māori]
Ko te māimoa i tatari
(The cat waited)
I tōna tikiti, tekau mā whitu
(For its ticket, forty-seven)
Ko te māimoa i tatari
(The cat waited)
Kāore i haere i mua i tōna wā
(Did not leave before its time)
Ko te māimoa i tatari
(The cat waited)
Ā, i tae mai tōna nama
(Until its number came)
Ko te māimoa i tatari
(The cat waited)
Ā, i whakaaro pai ia
(And it considered this reasonable)

[Bridge - all three]
The savings account is still active
La cuenta de ahorros todavía está activa
Kei te ora tonu te pūkete tiaki moni
The cat has not returned — El gato no ha regresado — Kāore anō te māimoa i hoki mai
The bank manager does not know what to do about this
El gerente del banco no sabe qué hacer al respecto
Kāore te kaiwhakahaere pēke e mōhio ana me aha

[Outro]
The interest rate is reasonable
La tasa de interés es razonable
He pai te reiti whiwhi
